scenes.heading: Welcome to Lampstand
scenes.sub: Five minutes, for everyone on the team
scenes.say: Welcome to Lampstand. This short video is for everyone on the team, not only the person at the projection computer.
Lampstand makes one promise: Sunday must not fail. It works without the internet, and the screen in the room never shows a desktop.

scenes.heading: Plan: during the week
scenes.say: Plan is where the service is built during the week. Put songs, Bible readings and slides in order. Anyone on the team can help, from their own computer.

scenes.heading: Present: on Sunday
scenes.say: Present is for Sunday. One service is open at a time, and every slide of it is laid out. The card marked LIVE is what the room sees. Press Space to move on.

scenes.heading: Setup: once, then rarely
items: Who does what, on which computer
scenes.say: Setup is for the media volunteer: which screen is the projector, how the words look, and who does what. It is set once, then left alone.

scenes.heading: Switch any time
items: On a Mac, use ⌘ instead of Ctrl
scenes.say: Switch with Control and one for Plan, Control and two for Present, or Control and backslash to go back and forth. On a Mac, use Command.

scenes.heading: Learn by running it
scenes.say: Training Session 0 is itself a service. Training Session 1 teaches you to run one. Training Session 2 practises the surprises. They work offline and never change your own services.

scenes.heading: Press Space to carry on
scenes.action: Next: Plan and Present, slide by slide
